correctness.rationale: The exact (empty,single,full)-triangle Markov quotient and both conditional binomial marginals follow from the closed-neighborhood forcing rule. A left-Perron moment bound proves the lower completion-time threshold; Bernoulli warm-up, conditional Chernoff lower bounds, a positive two-type Perron eigenvector, and double-exponential white-vertex depletion prove the matching upper threshold. A published star comparison gives uniformly logarithmic residual expectation and a geometric-block second moment, so convergence in probability upgrades to convergence in mean. The separate standalone exact-rational checker passed 581 assertions against full-coloring dynamics for small graphs; finite checks are not used to infer an infinite theorem.

value.rationale: The 2019 universal-hub family theorem leaves a genuine sharp constant gap for a natural motif-rich graph. The matching outer edges introduce a two-stage amplification matrix with Perron root 1+sqrt(2), quantitatively changing the logarithmic time coefficient compared with a star of the same hub degree. Establishing matching in-probability and mean constants for the entire friendship family is a structurally motivated asymptotic result, not a small-graph Markov-table computation.
